camel_example: aliyun alidns DescribeDnsProductInstances --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy createDate --VersionCode version1 --DomainType PUBLIC --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --UserClientIp '192.0.2.0' --Lang en --Direction DESC
description_en: Queries paid DNS product instances based on the specified parameters
description_zh: 根据传入参数获取付费版DNS产品实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-dns-product-instances --lang en --user-client-ip 192.0.2.0 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --version-code version1 --domain-type PUBLIC --order-by createDate --direction DESC --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDnsProductInstances

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：
zh：中文
en：英文

默认：en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the client
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The paging Settings for the number of entries to return on each page in a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The code of the Alibaba Cloud DNS product
parameters.name: version_code

parameters.help_en:
The domain name type. This parameter is not case-sensitive. Valid values:

PUBLIC: authoritative hosted domain name. Default value.

CACHE: authoritative proxy domain name
parameters.help_zh:
域名类型，大小写不敏感。取值：

PUBLIC：权威托管域名（默认值）

CACHE：权威代理域名
parameters.name: domain_type

parameters.help_en:
The sorting parameter. Valid values:
createDate: sorts by creation time. If this parameter is left empty, the instances are sorted by creation time by default.
expireDate: sorts by expiration time
parameters.help_zh:
排序参数。取值：
createDate：按创建时间排序（为空时默认按创建时间排序）
expireDate：按过期时间排序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order. Valid values:
DESC: descending order. If this parameter is left empty, the instances are sorted in descending order by default. 
ASC: ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值：
DESC：递减（为空时默认递减排序） 
ASC: 递增
parameters.name: direction

DnsProduct.description_en: The list of paid DNS product instances returned by the query
DnsProduct.description_zh: 本次获取的付费版DNS产品实例列表

AutoRenewal.description_en:
The renewal status. Valid values:
true: Auto-renewal is enabled.
false: Auto-renewal is disabled
AutoRenewal.description_zh:
续费状态。
true：自动续费类型。
false：非自动续费类型

BindCount.description_en: The maximum number of times the domain name bound to the paid DNS instance can be changed. This parameter is applicable to users of the Custom Edition
BindCount.description_zh: 适用于定制版用户调用，指付费版DNS实例可支持更换域名次数

BindDomainCount.description_en: The maximum number of domain names that can be bound to the paid DNS instance. This parameter is applicable to users of the Personal Edition and Enterprise Ultimate Edition
BindDomainCount.description_zh: 适用于个人版、企业旗舰版用户调用，指付费版DNS实例可以绑定的域名个数

BindDomainUsedCount.description_en: The number of domain names that are bound to the paid DNS instance. This parameter is applicable to users of the Personal Edition and Enterprise Ultimate Edition
BindDomainUsedCount.description_zh: 适用于个人版、企业旗舰版用户调用，指付费版DNS实例已绑定使用的域名个数

BindUsedCount.description_en: The number of times the domain name bound to the paid DNS instance has been changed. This parameter is applicable to users of the Custom Edition
BindUsedCount.description_zh: 适用于定制版用户调用，指付费版DNS实例已使用的更换域名次数

DDosDefendFlow.description_en: The DNS protection traffic, in Gbit/s

DDosDefendQuery.description_en: The DNS protection QPS, in ten thousand QPS. This parameter is applicable to users of the Custom Edition
DDosDefendQuery.description_zh: 适用于定制版用户调用，DNS防护QPS（万qps）

DnsSLBCount.description_en: The load balancing capacity, which is the maximum number of IP addresses that can be configured for a single domain name on a single line
DnsSLBCount.description_zh: 负载均衡（单域名、单线路的IP地址容量）

DnsSecurity.description_en:
The DNS security level. Valid values:
no: No security protection is required.
basic: basic protection against DNS attacks.
advanced: best-effort protection against DNS attacks
DnsSecurity.description_zh:
DNS安全。取值：
no：不需要
basic：dns攻击基础防御
advanced：dns攻击全力防御

EndTime.description_en: The time when the instance expires. The time is displayed in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ

EndTimestamp.description_en: The time when the instance expires. The value is a UNIX timestamp
